It’s a “cute” template but there are a few hiccups with this template that can lead to data error. 1 the values from the expense categories do not appear on all dashboards leading to miscalculations. 2 the “net expense” formula actually subtracts tax and fees from the total which makes no sense because most businesses incur those costs so instead it should be “gross expense” lastly I reached out to let the creator know about the glitch, in the form and they did not provide helpful solutions.
